✦ Who We Are

Our Mission & Vision

Our Mission

To help people grow in their relationship with God, walk in unity with one another, and live with purpose as disciples of Jesus Christ.

Our Vision

In the next 5–10 years, Journey of Faith will be a thriving, Bible-centered church where every believer is growing spiritually, serving faithfully, and impacting the community for God's glory.

✦ Our Foundation

What We Believe

Our faith is rooted in the truth of God's Word and the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

1
The Bible is God's Word
The Bible is the inspired and authoritative Word of God — our foundation for faith, growth, and daily life.
2
Salvation Through Jesus Christ
Salvation comes through faith in Jesus Christ alone — not by works, but by grace through belief in Him.
3
Death & Resurrection of Jesus
The death and resurrection of Jesus Christ brings forgiveness, freedom, and new life to all who believe.
4
Love God, Love People
We are called to love God, love people, and live out our faith daily — in our homes, community, and beyond.
Statement of Faith

"Journey of Faith believes in one God — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit — and in the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ for our salvation. We follow the Bible as God's Word, guiding our faith, worship, and daily life. We are called to grow in relationship with God, use our gifts to serve others, and live in love, unity, and purpose for the building of His Kingdom."

✦ About Us

A Body of Christ Built on the Word

Journey of Faith is a body of Christ that teaches the Word to foster personal relationships of each believer with God. We welcome all denominations to come together in the knowledge of the Word of God, the love of God, and the use of God-given gifts for the uplifting of His kingdom.

With the belief that God will bless that which is done decently, in order, and in line with the teaching of God's Word, the Journey of Faith family moves forward in love. We understand that true relationship with God is a journey that takes perseverance and prayer, not perfection.

We invite you to join us in prayer, praise, and worship as we enter into fellowship for kingdom building. May the love and peace of God be with you!

✦ Our Pastor

Bishop Kelvin Leonard

Over 40 Years in Ministry

Bishop Kelvin Leonard has been in ministry for over 40 years, first under the leadership of his father, the late Bishop Josh Leonard Jr. His steadfast belief in God's word, his unwavering love without judgement, and his desire to see the people of God saved and living in peace sustains him.

He is assisted in ministry by his loving wife, Veronica Leonard. He has been blessed with children and grandchildren and desires to teach his family of God's redeeming love.

✦ Community

Fellowship & Ministries

There's a place for everyone in our family. Find your community and grow together in faith.

Sister to Sister

A community of women who love God and endeavor to show the love of God to one another through fellowship and prayer.

Journey Kids

Our next generation of believers. They learn and share the love of God through crafts, songs, dances, and praise.

Journey Men

A community of men who love God and desire to strengthen each other in Godly fellowship.
